kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Key profitability indicator for the company, subject to fluctuations based on program mix, production volumes, product complexity, and material costs

kpis.name: Headcount

risks.title: Demand Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions customer demand fluctuations as a major risk in its forward-looking statements. These fluctuations have direct consequences on financial results and production capacity utilization.

risks.title: Supply Chain Constraints
risks.score_rationale: The company identifies supply chain constraints as a persistent risk. Although some material constraints have eased, limitations remain for legacy technologies and certain components, affecting production capacity.

risks.title: Geopolitical Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly identifies geopolitical uncertainties, including ongoing hostilities, tensions, trade restrictions, sanctions, and retaliatory measures, as risks affecting operations and financial results.

risks.title: Regulatory and Tariff Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions tariff risks, trade restrictions, and sanction restrictions as sources of uncertainty. Tariffs and customs retaliatory measures may increase material costs and impact margins.

risks.title: Dependence on a Limited Number of Customers
risks.score_rationale: The top 10 customers represent 51% of sales in 2025. Applied Materials alone accounts for 14%. The loss of a major customer without replacement would have a material adverse impact on financial results.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange and Interest Rate Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions the effects of foreign currency fluctuations and high interest rates as factors of uncertainty affecting financial condition and operational results.

risks.title: Inflationary Pressures
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly cites ongoing inflationary pressures as a factor of uncertainty. These pressures impact material costs, labor costs, and overall operating expenses.

ai_positioning.summary: BHE does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses primarily on financial aspects, business segments, and company operations, with no specific reference to AI technologies.
